_comment: Komet benchmark profiles for scripts/bench.sh. The script merges world + profiles.<name>, adds output, modDir, revision and
env, and hands the result to the game as KOMET_BENCH. Only overrides belong here: the defaults and ranges live in
Komet/Bench/BenchConfig.cs. Arm knobs are the names in Komet/Core/Knobs.cs, with their ranges; flags take true/false.
"engine": true starts the arm from every knob's engine value. Laps must be a multiple of the arm count.
sandbox is read by the script only: window size, windowMode (0 windowed, 1 fullscreen), vsync, fps cap, view distance,
boot timeout, extra environment for the game process, and hud: keys merged into komet-hud.json (e.g. Visible).

smoke._comment: about three minutes: proves the harness end to end, A/A so the two arms must agree

aa._comment: the noise floor: full length, both arms identical; |delta| here is what any A/B has to beat

full._comment: Komet as configured against the engine (every knob at its engine value), A B B A A B B A

tess._comment: the tessellation fast paths and TessSchedule on against off, in one process; compare tessMsPerPass and tessNearAvg (marks near the player still waiting), where new chunks stream in

gcreg._comment: the always-on features outside the tessellation fast paths (shape init memo, entity budget, particle light) on against off, in one process: frame time and GC pauses

hud._comment: the HUD itself in game: every panel shown, one lap, to catch what unit tests cannot (Cairo, GL uploads, the frame clock)
